options.label: Disabled snap revisions
options.description: Old revisions kept by snapd for rollback (`snap remove <name> --revision=<rev>`). Close affected snaps first.

options.label: Keep fewer revisions in future
options.description: Runs `snap set system refresh.retain=<n>` with the value from Preferences (2–20).

options.label: Downloaded snap blobs
options.description: /var/lib/snapd/cache. Mostly hard links to installed snaps; only unshared files free space.

options.label: Unused runtimes (your account)
options.description: Runs `flatpak uninstall --user --unused -y`. Size is an estimate.

options.label: Unused runtimes (system)
options.description: Runs `flatpak uninstall --system --unused -y`. Size is an estimate.
